steps.eval: (() => { const dialog = document.querySelector('[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]'); if (!dialog) throw new Error('F1 未打开帮助弹窗'); const title = (dialog.querySelector('h2')?.innerText || '').trim(); if (title !== '帮助与快速上手') throw new Error('帮助标题不符: ' + title); const cards = dialog.querySelectorAll('.grid > div'); if (cards.length < 4) throw new Error('帮助摘要主题不足 4 个: ' + cards.length); const full = [...dialog.querySelectorAll('button')].find((node) => (node.innerText || '').includes('打开完整帮助')); if (!full) throw new Error('缺少「打开完整帮助」入口'); const keys = dialog.querySelectorAll('kbd'); if (keys.length < 4) throw new Error('摘要缺少快捷键表: ' + keys.length); return { open: true, title, cards: cards.length, shortcuts: keys.length }; })()

(() => { const dialogs = document.querySelectorAll('[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"]'); if (dialogs.length !== 0) throw new Error('打开完整帮助后摘要弹窗仍在'); const section = document.querySelector('#settings-help'); if (!section) throw new Error('未跳转到设置 → 帮助中心'); const title = (section.querySelector('h2')?.innerText || '').trim(); if (!title) throw new Error('帮助中心分节缺少标题'); return { open: false, dialogs: 0, section: 'settings-help', title }; })()
